relevance_note: Single case report of a woman carrying a PSTPIP1 variant: 'a known pathogenic variant associated with PAMIs: c.G748 (E250K) in the PSTPIP1 gene'.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON. One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (single unnamed case-report patient). Variant printed as 'c.G748 (E250K)' (non-standard cDNA, no transcript, protein without 'p.'); recorded as printed: cdna 'c.G748', protein 'E250K'. The Background mentions 'p.E250K and p.E257K' and 'missense mutations' for PAMIs in general; not used for this patient's variant fields (D-29), so variant type, zygosity and inheritance are not reported. Age at genetic diagnosis is given only as 'Thirty years after the onset of signs and symptoms' (not an age as written), so age_at_diagnosis is not reported; at the age of 17 is the PH diagnosis, not the PAMI diagnosis. Age 31 years taken as age at report. Functional evidence is patient-level transcriptome/interferon-signature data, not a variant-specific assay. Possible inconsistency: text says 'Laboratory tests confirmed pancytopenia (Table 2)' but Table 2 lists platelets 334 x 10^9/L and hemoglobin '12 g/L'; numeric table values were not interpreted, and both pancytopenia statements are recorded as observed. Cardiac involvement 'excluded' refers only to the first hospitalization at 7 months; later RV dilation and PH are recorded as observed. Family history of spontaneous abortions on the father's side is not a feature of the patient and was not recorded; no relatives are described individually.

treatment_summary.value: steroid infiltrations and oral NSAIDs for arthritis and fever; growth hormone replacement until 18 years; bosentan (discontinued for raised aminotransferase) and sildenafil with cyclophosphamide 750 mg/month for 10 months and prednisone; sildenafil stopped 2017, PDE5i monotherapy restarted; hydroxychloroquine 200 mg b.i.d.
span: requiring steroid infiltrations and oral NSAIDs
a replacement therapy with GH was initiated and continued until the patient reached 18 years of age

Upfront double combination therapy with bosentan 62.5 mg b.i.d. and sildenafil 40 mg t.i.d was started for PAH in addition to double immune modulating (suppressive) therapy with cyclophosphamide 750 mg/month for 10 months and prednisone. However, bosentan was early discontinued due to an increase in hepatic aminotransferase.
Monotherapy with PDE5i was started with rapid improvement of symptoms and reduction in sPAP levels.
hydroxychloroquine 200 mg b.i.d. was introduced to contrast interferon‐mediated inflammation
